messages.name: load_skill
messages.content: # Emails An email is an Email Template drawn on the HTML canvas, saved with save_email_template. The tool writes it as Gmail and Outlook need it: a 600px column of tables with inline styles. The subject and the text take Jinja against a record as `doc`. ## Steps Make the emails the person names, each under the name they give it. A message that only sets the style of the emails to come names none: say which style you will use and wait for them. 1. Run `describe` on the DocType each email is about. Use its real fieldnames and exact Select options. 2. Save each email with save_email_template. Check `sample_subject` and `sample_text` in the result. 3. Make the automations that send them (see Sending). 4. For an announcement to many people, fill an email group (see Announcements). ## One style for every email Write the header and the footer once, and copy them into every email of a set unchanged. Change only the body. The header carries the same lockup as the event's other artifacts, such as its badge: the name and the date line. Every email opens with a greeting. ```yaml el: body style: {background: '#ffffff', fontFamily: Helvetica, color: '#111827', borderRadius: 8px, --backdrop: '#f4f4f5'} c: - el: div name: Header style: {background: '#0f172a', padding: 24px 32px, borderRadius: 8px 8px 0 0} c: - el: h1 text: Frappeverse 2027 style: {color: '#ffffff', fontSize: 22px, fontWeight: '700'} - el: p text: 20–21 Aug · Mumbai style: {color: '#ffffff', opacity: '0.7', fontSize: 13px} - el: div name: Body style: {padding: 32px, display: flex, flexDirection: column, gap: 16px} c: - el: p text: "Hi {{ (doc.full_name or '').split(' ')[0] }}," style: {fontSize: 16px, lineHeight: '1.6'} - el: p text: "Your {{ doc.ticket_type }} ticket is confirmed. Your ticket code is {{ doc.ticket_code }}." style: {fontSize: 16px, lineHeight: '1.6'} - el: a name: Button text: See the schedule attrs: {href: /frappeverse/schedule} style: {background: '#2563eb', color: '#ffffff', padding: 12px 20px, borderRadius: 6px, fontWeight: '600', fontSize: 15px} - el: div name: Footer style: {padding: 20px 32px, borderTop: '1px solid #e5e7eb'} c: - el: p text: 20 and 21 August 2027 · Nehru Centre, Worli, Mumbai style: {fontSize: 13px, color: '#6b7280'} ``` - A flex column with `gap` stacks blocks. A flex row with `gap` makes columns. - A link with a `background` is a button. A path such as /frappeverse/schedule becomes the site's full URL. - `--backdrop` on the root is the color around the 600px column. - Use Helvetica or Arial. Write colors as values: email clients ignore CSS variables, grids, icons and SVG, so the tool refuses them. QR codes are SVG: they belong on a print format. ## Jinja - A field: `{{ doc.ticket_code }}`. A first name: `{{ (doc.full_name or '').split(' ')[0] }}`. - The subject is Jinja too: `Your talk is in: {{ doc.title }}`. - Quote every value that starts with `{`. Inside it, use single quotes. - `doctype` in save_email_template is the DocType the email is about, such as Attendee or Talk Proposal. - The email goes to a person: the one named by the record's email field. Greet them by the name field beside it, such as `speaker_name` for `speaker_email`, never by the record's title. - A Select value is a label, not prose. Turn each one a sentence shows into words with a map: `Your {{ {'Talk 25 min': 'talk', 'Lightning 10 min': 'lightning talk', 'Workshop 90 min': 'workshop'}.get(doc.format, 'talk') }} is in the {{ doc.track }} track.` Read `sample_text` back and fix any sentence that still shows a raw value. ## Sending An Automation Flow sends a template with a `SendNotification` step. Create it with the `create` tool. `recipients` takes the record's email field as Jinja. Title it after the template it sends, so one event has one name: `Send Registration Confirmed`. When a record is created: ```json { "title": "Send Registration Confirmed", "enabled": 1, "document_type": "Attendee", "trigger_type": "Doc Created", "actions": [ { "step_type": "Action", "action_type": "SendNotification", "params": {"channel": "Email", "recipients": ["{{ doc.email }}"], "email_template": "Registration Confirmed"} } ] } ``` When a field changes to a value, such as a proposal's status to Accepted: `"trigger_type": "Field Value Changed"`, `"trigger_field": "status"`, `"to_value": "Accepted"`, and `"recipients": ["{{ doc.speaker_email }}"]`. ## Announcements An announcement is an Email Template sent to an Email Group. 1. Save the template with the people's DocType as `doctype`. A group email renders against each member, which has only `email`, so write the announcement without names or other fields. Open it with "Hi there,". 2. Fill the group with fill_email_group: its title and the DocType. It adds a member per record with an email, and skips those already in it. 3. Send it with send_email_template only when the person says to send it. Until then it stays unsent.
